title: Cape Town International Airport — ground transportation guide
claims: Cape Town International Airport is about 20 km from downtown Cape Town and the journey usually takes 20–30 minutes depending on traffic.
The A01 MyCiTi bus runs between the airport and the Civic Centre bus station in downtown Cape Town, every 20–30 minutes, roughly 05:00–22:00, about 30 minutes, and requires a MyConnect card.
The airport has buses, shuttles, metered taxis, ride-hailing services and car rentals.

verification.note: Independent airport guide; used only for generic distance and transport modes, not as the race organiser's shuttle policy.
